page_title: ALA 1-0 RSO | Alaves v Real Sociedad 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yusi (Alaves) replaces Denis Suarez.
90+2' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' Mikel Goti Lopez (Real Sociedad) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
88' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' Substitution. Carlos Soler makes his way off the pitch and Mikel Goti Lopez (Real Sociedad) comes on as his replacement.
86' Jon Karrikaburu (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Javier Alberola signals.

85' Victor Parada (Alaves) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.

83' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
82' Poor challenge! Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is penalised for tripping and Javier Alberola blows his whistle.
78' A substitution has been made. Takefusa Kubo is replaced by Jon Karrikaburu (Real Sociedad).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Gorrotxategi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
76' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Abderrahmane Rebbach and he is replaced by Carles Alena (Alaves).
76' Here's the change. Ander Guevara leaves the pitch and Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) comes on as a substitute.
75' A corner kick by Alaves is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).
75' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Lucas Boye (Alaves)! That was a huge opportunity!
74' Javier Alberola interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ander Guevara (Alaves).

73' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
73' Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
73' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
72' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
69' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) serves up a nice cross, but Alex Remiro punches the ball away.
65' The cross into the penalty area from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
63' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ander Guevara (Alaves) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

61' Real Sociedad hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
58' What an opportunity! Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
57' Denis Suarez (Alaves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
56' Sergio Francisco prepares a substitution. Aritz Elustondo is replaced by Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Umar Sadiq.
55' A brilliant individual effort! Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
54' Referee Javier Alberola sees the trip by Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
53' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

53' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top right corner, but Alex Remiro has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Alaves win a corner.
51' Eduardo Coudet has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Vicente (Alaves) replacing Calebe.
48' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' 1 - 0 Goal! Alex Remiro gets a hand on the penalty from Lucas Boye (Alaves), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
45+4' Lucas Boye (Alaves) is going to take the penalty!
45+3' It’s a PENALTY to Alaves after the VAR review!
45+3' Referee Javier Alberola makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Alaves. Let’s see what happens!
45+2' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
45+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

44' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Alaves are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
42' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alex Remiro is quickest to intercept the ball.
41' Denis Suarez (Alaves) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
39' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
39' Lucas Boye (Alaves) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
35' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
35' Fouls committed – 8:6.
31' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
29' The game has begun to heat up. Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
27' Flag goes up against Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
25' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Javier Alberola blows his whistle for an infringement.
24' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) commits a foul and Javier Alberola immediately signals a free kick.
24' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Calebe (Alaves). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
22' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
21' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Calebe (Alaves), but Alex Remiro is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
17' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

13' What an opportunity! Lucas Boye (Alaves) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
13' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Javier Alberola stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
11' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
9' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' Jonny Otto (Alaves) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Alaves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
8' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
5' Alex Remiro displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Lucas Boye (Alaves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
4' A clumsy foul by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) and Javier Alberola blows his whistle.
2' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The match has just started.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Javier Alberola is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
